description: This file is a Python source module that implements generation of type stub (.pyi) files for PyTorch, focusing on enabling IDE autocomplete and type checking. It includes functions for generating type hints for PyTorch functions, handling external dependencies, and collecting docstrings for documentation.

methods.name: get_py_torch_functions
methods.description: Groups Python signatures of torch functions or methods for generating type stubs, based on whether they are functions or methods.

methods.name: gather_docstrs
methods.description: Collects docstrings from mocked torch modules to include in generated type stubs.

methods.name: add_docstr_to_hint
methods.description: Formats a docstring to be added to a type hint, embedding the docstring as a comment or property.

methods.name: gen_pyi
methods.description: Main function to generate the .pyi type stub files for PyTorch, including signatures and docstrings.
